description_en: Deletes a specified version of a dataset. This operation cannot be used to delete version v1. Version v1 is deleted with the dataset when you call the DeleteDataset operation
description_zh: 删除指定版本的数据集信息。其中版本v1无法使用本接口删除，需要使用DeleteDataset接口删除数据集的时候同步删除
kebab_example: aliyun aiworkspace delete-dataset-version --dataset-id d-lfd60v0p0000ujtsdx --version-name v2 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DeleteDatasetVersion

parameters.help_en: The dataset ID. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/457222.html
parameters.help_zh: 数据集ID。如何获取数据集ID，详情请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/457222.html
parameters.name: dataset_id

parameters.help_en: The dataset version. The version must be later than v1. Version v1 is deleted when the dataset is deleted
parameters.help_zh: 数据集版本。版本号需要大于v1，v1版本会在删除数据集的时候同步删除
parameters.name: version_name
